name: *FOREMAN* Trash Landfill Tycoon
desc:
LANDFILL TYCOON

Run your own county landfill. Trucks roll across the scale and tip on your floors, you push the trash into the cell, bury it, compact it, and build the hill lift by lift until it closes.

Start on foot hauling bags, then buy your first machine. Skid steer, small and large dozers, a landfill compactor, and two magnet excavators, all drivable with working blades, buckets, and magnets. Hire laborers and operators, assign them to a tipping floor, and watch them run the site while you expand.

Open scrap recycling and a hazmat permit for bigger paydays, sign hauling contracts, survive wind and seagulls, and pass the county inspection. Sell the closed landfill for a permanent pay bonus and start again bigger.
